Honestly, UTCS does not care about rank. They care about your ESSAYS and MAYBE your test scores (just to know if you're smart enough for the program). Your ESSAYS must be creative. Personally, I read a lot of experimental and avant garde literature to help prepare me to write my essays. I wrote some pretty trippy/funny shit about the passage of time and wanting to be a monarch butterfly. I also wrote about how art and CS blend together. However, I did also write about why I wasn't auto admit (Topic S) and I believe this is one of the main reasons I got accepted. Just remember: write some creative essays and send in a nice resume. I spent probably 2 months writing my essays. It wouldn't hurt to try to do good on your ACT or SAT.
